text_block_list.text: There was an awkward amount of time left before Orfevre's next appointment. It was too short to bother returning to the academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You there, provide me some entertainment.
To pass the time.

"...This might be a chance for redemption
after giving her such a boring time
on our outing the other day."

Something we can provide around here, and—
learning from last time, something with short wait times
that can be enjoyed smoothly would be...

This karaoke box is fully stocked with party props.
I think we could enjoy ourselves in all sorts of ways while singing, but...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

Orfevre begins operating the remote control.
It seems she's in the mood to sing something. In that case,
to hype things up, I could grab a tambourine or—
(—Ba-dum-dum, ta-da~♪)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You shall sing. And do not forget to dance.
(One, two, three, four!)

(Ta-da-da-dum♪ Ta-da-da-dum♪
Ta-da-da-dum-dum~~♪)
I've been made to sing and dance to the same song ever since, and this is already the fifth time...! My stamina's drained, but more than that, dancing all by myself is so brutal...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. I've grown bored of this.
Next.

Pulling myself together... next, I'll take her to a cafe!
Apparently, they have sweets made in collaboration with a famous French pastry chef.

text_block_list.name: Fairytale Uniform Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting~!
Here is the special collaboration crème brûlée, along with the set's plushie & ear headband♡
...It was an incredibly fairytale-like shop! As a bonus with the collab menu, I even received some equally fairytale-like merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Fascinating. You put it on.

"I held the plushie I received from Orfevre
and put on the bunny ears. —All of this,
just to provide her with an entertaining spectacle...!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ............Heh. How bizarre.
choice_data_list: (She smiled at me... wait, or did she laugh at me...?)

text_block_list.text: In that manner, I provided all sorts of entertainment, but...

I'm really running out of ideas now...
What should I do next—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"Ahhh! It's Orfevre!!"
"Gimme an 'autograph'!"
"King, play with us!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Good, good. Don't be so hasty.

In no time at all, she was surrounded by children...
Surprisingly, she seems to be in a good mood.
—In that case, let's turn this situation into an entertainment piece!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Let's play together!
Let's play in the mud!
choice_data_list: Then how about offering a treasure to the king?

text_block_list.text: "Let's make the best mud dumplings ever and give them to the King as a present. Who can make the greatest treasure? Let's see!" I propose the contest to the kids.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do it!
I'm super good at it!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Very well, keep up the good work.

Getting covered in mud while working hard to make mud dumplings with the kids.
It seemed Orfevre thoroughly enjoyed that as well—

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Lady Orfe, here you go!
I'm giving you a treasure!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. You've polished this quite well.
...And this one is a rather original piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Good, very good. Another gem has been added
to my treasury. You have all done exceedingly well.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Lady Orfe, bye-byee!

Let's make sure to preserve the treasures made by the children.
If I recall correctly, there's a specific method to make mud dumplings last a long time.
choice_data_list: I'll keep everything safe over here

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Let's leave it to them.

—She really seems to be in good spirits...
The time she spent surrounded by the children
might have been when she had the most fun today.
Perhaps for Orfevre's entertainment, being surrounded by as many people as possible is what matters most. That was good to learn.
choice_data_list: Did that provide a little entertainment?
Even so, Orfevre is really kind.
Even so, Orfevre is really kind.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ah... That wasn't bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Watching you struggle against the odds
was quite entertaining, after all.

Remembering the time I struggled through karaoke made me feel a bit pathetic...
but all's well that ends well!

Though being surrounded by a big crowd made it feel like proper entertainment
and put her in good spirits, she was remarkably gentle
in how she interacted with the children.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
............Your way of thinking is
always so utterly bizarre.
For some reason, they looked at me as if I were a bizarre creature. While I tilted my head, wondering if I'd said something that strange, they scoffed at me through their nose.
